reviews.comment: We watched a PragerU video in class, that's all you need to know
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lecture is pretty useless and kind of boring, but he gives tons of extra credit and is very lenient with grading. It's not hard to get an A if you do the homework and study a little before the exams. Not bad overall.

RUN, don't walk away from this class. Haydon made coming to class horrifying because of the things that came out of his mouth. He goes on rants every single class, ranging from 10 minutes to the entire lecture time, regarding his opinions about current events. You will not be able to get through the class's material and you will learn nothing.

Professor Haydon somehow made an easy class difficult. I recommend going to the lectures for extra credit opportunities, but he honestly just rambles about his conservative viewpoints and fails to teach the material. The exams cover content that was not taught in class nor the textbook. I would suggest taking a different professor for pols.

Sweet guy, lots of extra credit for those that attend class, but lectures are kind of useless. All grades were online, and he had a nice review session before the midterm. His content does lean conservative despite his claims of being politically neutral/ independent; however, that is not a reason to not take him. Overall, I would take him again.

The class isn't an easy A. A majority of your grade will come from 2 hard exams (lockdown browser w/ camera). The only other work is 15 quizzes (answers on quizlet). However, do not hesitate to email him for help. Doing this brought me from a low B to an A, as he's very understanding, accommodating, and wants to see his students do well.

Only 2 exams. His lectures were just discussion and no actual teaching. Some of the content on the exams I had seen no where in the textbook or on his slides. Attend class for extra credit! He only gave 1 review session and cancelled the last one for the final, which was annoying. There are better options for professors in my opinion.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Class is very easy I put pretty much no effort in and made a B just read the textbook (I didn't even fully read the textbook or else I would've made an A) however the textbook is lonngggg. It is interesting when you get around to reading it though

honestly dont take this class if you want an easy A. this class is so test heavy that one bad grade will drop you down two letters. Do not recommend this class at all. I took it online btw. worst mistake ever, literally harder than both my chemistry and biology classes

The class is entirely based on the online textbook & 10-14 corresponding chapter quizzes. Averaged 40 pages a week for this class. Only 2 exams (midterm & final) so very test-heavy. His lectures were usually off-topic & useless for the exams. Extra credit in class & at the end tho.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Goated prof who loves to talk politics in a fair environment. Only assignments are one quiz per chapter (12 total) and exams. Basically no work and straightforward exams. Understanding guy too. Go to class because he gives surprise extra credit. Dont let the quizzes build up, do one a week and study for exams and its the easiest POLS credit ever.

Haydon mainly used Vantage as his grades. There are weekly quizzes with three attempts each and you keep the highest grade. Write down the questions and answers for study material as the tests are based on this. He also gives a lot of extra credit. I could have easily gotten an A but I wasn't locked in.

Haydon is a nice guy, but it's difficult to do well in his class if you aren't passionate about political science. There are 2 exams and 10 quizzes that make up your grade, and some extra credit if you go to class. I don't have any particular care about political science so tests were super hard for me. Skill issue.

Haydon was a great professor! He gave out extra credit 3 times if you did extra assignments and showed up to class on certain days. The class is a final, midterm, and 10 online quizzes. I highly recommend him. He's also super easy to contact if you have questions. Look in files on Canvas and all of the slides and extra notes will be there.

I took POLS 206 online, and the class essentially consisted of reading the textbook and taking notes, chapter quizzes, and a 100 question midterm and final. I suggest you take notes from his slides and also read the textbook. He gives extra credit depending on what chapter you finish the semester with. Overall an easy professor for this core class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This course is not super difficult, but the grades are very heavily Test-Concentrated. For the online section of the class the two exams make up 400 of the 500ish points in the grade, meaning that you have to do well on them to pass. The in-person class fell behind so there was a little extra credit available, but not enough to make a difference.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Haydon is an amazing professor. His lectures can be all over the place at times, but he is very funny. He is also very accessible outside of class and will respond to emails very quickly. The course is pretty self-paced besides the exams and the textbook is online. He curves and gives a lot of extra credit.

The exams are worth a lot of the grade, so study. Lectures were really all over the place and some exam questions are specific, even though he says they won't be. I would have had a B but I took advantage of the extra credit and it bumped up by grade a lot. Overall a nice guy and he will adjust for the class as needed
Very relaxed, do the work and get an A

Dr. Haydon is a truly caring and funny person. There's TONS of extra credit and he rounds grades up at the end of the semester. The vantage quizzes are the only homework (each with 3 attempts) and there's 2 exams. Quiz questions come from the book and if you pay attention in class then you'll do good on the exams. He's the BEST pols professor!

He is very sweet and likes to discuss what he's teaching with the class. No homework just quizzes that are taken at your own pace and you have three attempts. Certain chapters are due before the test but they're pretty easy quizzes. Attendance isn't mandatory but go the day before tests or two days before the test because he might give hints ;).

Awesome prof! 

He made the class more interesting by having class discussions about modern day issues, which I enjoyed as a PoliSci major. I appreciated how he moderated discussions so people could safely voice their opinions. 

Two tests, a few quizzes, and tons of EC. Slides and textbook readings were helpful for the tests.
Great professor, entertaining lectures if you show up to class. Could totally only come in for only the midterm and final and still make an A if you study the lecture notes beforehand.

He's very chill as a professor. It was nice to hear his opinions on current politics and he always encouraged us to form our own opinions. Sometimes these talks would take too much time from the lectures, but he always provided the slides and lecture notes ahead of time. I recommend attending the lectures, just to listen as you read.

Dr. Haydon actually had me look forward to POLS lectures! Very caring, relatable, and funny; started the class with current Texas/U.S. politics discussions and didn't just read off his slides. 2 exams + ~11 quizzes (50% of grade each). Appreciated having a POLS professor who taught us the facts + truth, and wanted us to think for ourselves.

The class itself is mostly maintainable and there is not much work throughout the year besides the midterm and the final. He does not do a great job preparing student for these but the questions are not awful in all. Personally I did not go to class as he usually ended up on very politicized tangents that I didn't care to hear. He is very partial.
Great teacher, would talk about current politics at the beginning of each class and was funny to listen to. Hoping he rounds up my 89

There is no exams in this class. The only thing you are graded on is a final, a midterm, & easy at-home assignments. The final & midterm are tough, but he offers lots of extra credit! He is easy to get along with & a fair professor!

Easy to get an A if an effort is put in. Tests are fair but don't expect 100%. Responds to emails quickly, gives out ~6.5% of total grade as extra credit. 95% of assignments are quizzes, 3 attempts, some questions are unfair but expect 13/15 for all. Often derailed lectures by talking about national news/sometimes 70% of class would be irrelevant.

I liked professor Haydon. I personally don't like pols but he makes the class enjoyable and not too hard. There are chapter quizzes that are online, open note, and not hard if you stay on track throughout semester. There are 2 tests that are not hard but you do need to study. Lots of extra credit and nice professor. Best prof for POLS 207.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is pretty easy and it really didn't matter how good the professor was. There were only 2 tests and 11 quizzes, but he provided plenty of extra credit opportunities.
Probably the best professor you can get for POLS 206. Haydon makes this class very easy, it is all self paced on Sage Vantage besides the exams. Plenty of extra credit opportunities are given.

Haydon gives extra credit which makes getting an A doable but his structure is annoying. You don't need to go to class if you don't want to since a majority of his material is from his slides posted on canvas and the textbook. Go to the class before the test he gives answers. He is very partisan so he can get annoying quick sometimes.
Loved Professor Haydon and have recommended him to my friends. Would definitely take him again.

Fun professor! He is very caring and offers many extra credit opportunities. Mainly composed of two tests and a final. Other grades come from online test book chapter tests. Fairly easy, but not the most interesting. He means the best and will help you if he can. He seems to be right-winged so if you are not that, you may not like him that much.

I would not take him again. He just talks about his personal opinions and does not cover content that actually matters. He is rude and if you do not share his opinion he belittles you. I did not enjoy this course.

Great prof! I enjoyed Haydon because he did a review of current events during class. He genuinely wants to see you succeed and I highly recommend, even if you have to make the journey to VetMed. He's awesome!! Thank you Dr. Haydon!

I definitely recommend Haydon for POLS! He makes content easy to understand, and his lectures are fun and very interesting! We usually discuss current events before lecture starts, making class worth looking forward to! There are a lot of extra credit opportunities and quizzes/exams are pretty easy! Take this class!!!

He's so nice!!! The grade will be about half exam, half quizzes, except for some assignments he gives. This is intimidating, but the quizess are entirely off of textbook chapters, open note, three attempts each, and aren't that hard. The exam seems intimidating, but he reviews the material very well before the exam. He is very good, i recommend.

Take him! His goal is to make POLS easier. Genuinely cares about students. Communicate if you have issues. Extra credit at beginning/end of semester. Only tests are midterm/final. Other grades self-paced through required online textbook. Don't let them pile up. Attend lectures! Useful for understanding subject material and interesting/engaging.
